users.title: Users
users.onlyBaseRole: Only holds {role}, the baseline every member has.
users.rolesSubtitle: The list shows everyone holding a role beyond {role}, which every member has. Who is in a group is decided in Authentik, and what a group grants is changed under Roles.
users.whyLoading: Looking up where the roles come from…
users.whyFailed: Could not look up where the roles come from.
users.neverSeen: We have no group list for this member, because they have not signed in since we started keeping one. The roles below come from an earlier sign-in and cannot be traced until they sign in again.
users.noGrantedRoles: No roles beyond the baseline to trace.
users.leftoverExplained: A role with no group behind it is left over from an earlier sign-in: the mandate is gone from Authentik, but the role stays on the row until the holder next signs in. It clears itself then, and there is nothing to change in the mapping.
users.pending: Their next sign-in adds: {items}. Their Authentik groups have changed since the row was written.
users.groupsHint: Dimmed groups grant nothing here. Which group confers which role is edited under Roles.
users.payoutFailed: Could not look up account details.

cards.title: Guild cards
cards.last4Required: Enter the card's last four digits.
cards.deleteMessage: The card is removed from the register.
cards.deleteMessageLinked: The card is linked to {count, plural, one {# bank transaction} other {# bank transactions}}. They are kept but lose their link to the card.
cards.empty: No guild cards yet. Add a card or import a bank file.
cards.unassigned: Card ····{last4} no longer has a holder.
cards.unitUnassigned: Card ····{last4} no longer belongs to a result unit.
cards.unitAssignFailed: Could not change the result unit
cards.addHint: Cards are also added on their own when a bank file mentions a new card number.

costCenters.title: Cost centers
costCenters.newLocalSubtitle: Created here, not in Fortnox, and never sent along on export. For things that should not be booked on a cost center there, such as alcohol booked on a balance account.
costCenters.createFailed: Could not create the cost center
costCenters.updateFailed: Could not change the cost center
costCenters.deleteMessage: If the cost center is already used by an expense, a voucher or a budget it is retired instead of deleted, so what has already been booked still adds up.
costCenters.deleteFailed: Could not delete the cost center
costCenters.fortnoxHint: From Fortnox. Change it there and it comes along on the next sync.
costCenters.searchPlaceholder: Search codes, names or result units…
costCenters.emptyNone: No cost centers yet. Sync from Fortnox to pull them in.
costCenters.emptyNoMatch: No cost centers match the filter.

syncSummary.madeLocal: made {count} local since they are not in Fortnox

resultUnits.title: Result units
resultUnits.createFailed: Could not create the result unit
resultUnits.deleteMessage: The result unit has no prefixes and therefore owns no cost centers.
resultUnits.deleteMessagePrefixes: The prefixes {prefixes} are removed, and the cost centers they match are left without a result unit.
resultUnits.deleteFailed: Could not delete the result unit
resultUnits.renamed: The result unit is now called {name}.
resultUnits.noPrefixHint: Without a prefix the result unit owns no cost centers.
resultUnits.unassignedSubtitle: No prefix matches these, so only administrators can approve their expenses.
resultUnits.noCostCentersForPrefix: No cost centers match the result unit's prefixes.

income.removeBody: The product prefixes and voucher text are removed. The result unit, its cost centres and its owners stay. If it has booked reports it is retired instead.
income.descriptionHint: Shown on the voucher when a day's sales are booked.
income.noPrefixHint: No product prefixes yet. Products starting with one are booked to its account.
income.disabledHint: The unit takes no money in. Turn on sales to fetch and book them.
income.sectionHint: How the unit's sales at the till and via Swish are booked.
income.defaultCostCenterHint: Sales are booked on this cost center.
income.productHint: Goods whose name starts with the prefix belong to the unit and are booked on the account beside it. With the prefix c, c-Cola lands here, for example.
income.fallbackHint: Goods that match no unit land here.
income.noOwnCostCenters: The unit owns no cost centers yet. Add a prefix above.

resultUnits.noOwnerGroups: No group grants the role for this unit yet. Link a group under Roles.
resultUnits.noOwnersHolding: Nobody holds the post right now.
resultUnits.unassignedNotice: {count, plural, one {# active cost center has} other {# active cost centers have}} no result unit, so only administrators can attest their expenses.
resultUnits.sectionCostCentersHint: Every cost center whose code starts with one of the prefixes belongs to the unit.
resultUnits.matches: {count, plural, one {# cost center matches} other {# cost centers match}}
resultUnits.sectionAttestHint: Result owners attest expenses on the unit's cost centers.

fortnox.connectionSubtitle: The guild's link to Fortnox. Everything else here needs it connected.
fortnox.unconfigured: The server is missing the Fortnox client id, secret or redirect URI. Add them to the environment variables and restart.
fortnox.connectHint: Connect the guild's Fortnox account to export and sync. Requires you to be a system administrator in Fortnox.
fortnox.disconnectMessage: Export and sync stop working until someone connects again. The chart of accounts, cost centers and already-fetched ledger stay.
fortnox.voucherSeriesHint: The series exported vouchers land in.
fortnox.chartSyncFailed: Could not sync the chart of accounts
fortnox.bankAccountHint: Credited when a card purchase is booked.
fortnox.debtAccountHint: Credited when an out-of-pocket expense is to be reimbursed.
fortnox.openingBalancesNote: Opening balances (#IB) are fetched on sync. A year synced before the balance sheet existed has to be re-synced to show the right balances.
fortnox.bookingSubtitle: Where exported vouchers land and which accounts they credit.
fortnox.groupRegistersHint: The accounts and cost centers that expenses, budgets and vouchers point at.
fortnox.groupLedgerHint: Booked vouchers, one financial year at a time. Drives the Outcome reports.

booking.title: Bookkeeping
booking.description: Where the day's takings are booked. Accounts and the cost center save as soon as you pick them.

export.seriesHint: Empty = the same series as expenses ({series}). Give it one of its own to keep takings apart.
export.seriesHintUnconnected: Empty = the same series as expenses. Fortnox is not connected yet.

accounts.clearingHint: Debited when a day's takings are booked.
accounts.feeHint: Fees are a cost and book the other way round.
accounts.feeCostCenterHint: Fees do not belong to one committee.

committees.title: Committees
committees.description: The result units, and the income settings that let them take money in. One report per verksamhet per day; the prefixes decide what goes where.
committees.name: Name
committees.empty: No result units set up yet.
committees.removeBody: The income settings and prefixes are removed. The result unit itself stays.
committees.noFallback: No prefix is marked as the fallback. Products matching nothing have nowhere to go, and fetches will be refused.

fallbacks.title: Swish amounts
fallbacks.description: Payments with no usable message are matched on the exact amount.
fallbacks.hint: The message runs through the same prefix pipeline, so "c-Cola" lands with Cafémästeriet exactly as a labelled payment would.

roles.title: Roles & permissions
roles.outsideSection: {group} is outside the section. Only groups under dsek. grant anything here.
roles.removeGroupBody: {group} will stop granting roles and result units. This affects {count, plural, =0 {nobody right now} =1 {1 person} other {# people}}.
roles.capabilitiesSubtitle: What each role may do. Applies from the next page load, for everyone holding the role.
roles.attestNote: Attest authority is not on this grid. It is a rule in the code, not a tickbox. Whether an expense is yours to attest depends on whose it is, what roles the person who filed it holds, and which result unit the cost centre falls under. The approvals view above only decides whether the queue is visible.
roles.staleCounts: {count, plural, =1 {1 member has} other {# members have}} not signed in since group lists started being kept, and so are not counted in the group figures below. The role figures cover every member.
roles.savedAffecting: Saved. {count, plural, =1 {1 person} other {# people}} got new roles.
roles.confirmManyBody: {group} has {count} members. All of them get the change immediately.
roles.confirmWideTitle: A lot of people get this permission
roles.confirmWideBody: {role} has {count} people. All of them get {capability} immediately.
roles.confirmOwnTitle: You are taking something from yourself
roles.confirmOwnBody: You hold the {role} role. Removing {capability} from it removes it from you too.

expiry.title: Best-before reminder
expiry.hint: We never know what is printed on a crate. What we know is when a delivery arrived and how long the product keeps, and from that we ask somebody to go down and read the packaging.
expiry.leadDaysHint: How far ahead of the estimated date to start asking. 30 days is about right: a crate can be drunk in a month if somebody knows about it.

email.title: Email
email.mailOff: Sending is off here (SMTP_HOST is not set). Emails are written to the server log instead and shown as sent.
email.empty: No emails have been sent yet.
email.emptyPerson: No emails have been sent to this member.
email.retryHint: Sent again right away, with all attempts reset.
email.retryFailed: Could not queue the email again
email.testHint: Built from the member's real data: an expense they can see, their latest card transactions or what is waiting on them. [Test] is in the subject. Sent regardless of what the member has chosen in their profile.
email.testFailed: Could not send the test email
